title: What Makes Lake Natron Glow Red?

scenes.text: 4‑km alkaline lake that looks like liquid fire

scenes.label: HIGH SODIUM CARBONATE CONTENT
scenes.text: The lake’s soda‑rich water reflects sunlight, creating a crimson sheen.

scenes.label: THOUSANDS OF FLAMINGO BREEDERS
scenes.text: Its pink hue attracts massive flocks of lesser flamingos that feed on algae.

scenes.label: VOLCANIC GROUND SURROUNDINGS
scenes.text: Steep basaltic cliffs and nearby volcanoes add to the otherworldly scenery.

description: Lake Natron in Tanzania looks like a pool of molten lava, yet it’s a vital breeding ground for flamingos. Discover the chemistry and wildlife that give this lake its fiery glow.
